in_sanskrit.name: Subal
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Good, auspicious, kind
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Subal एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Suba means good and Al means auspicious. This name signifies a kind and good natured person who is blessed with auspiciousness.

in_tamil.name: Subal
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Good, auspicious, kind
in_tamil.long_meaning: Subal ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। Suba means good and Al means auspicious. This name signifies a kind and good natured person who is blessed with auspiciousness.

in_telugu.name: Subal
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Good, auspicious, kind
in_telugu.long_meaning: Subal ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। Suba means good and Al means auspicious. This name signifies a kind and good natured person who is blessed with auspiciousness.

in_marathi.name: Subal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Good, auspicious, kind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Suba means good and Al means auspicious. This name signifies a kind and good natured person who is blessed with auspiciousness.

in_bengali.name: Subal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Good, auspicious, kind
in_bengali.long_meaning: Subal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Suba means good and Al means auspicious. This name signifies a kind and good natured person who is blessed with auspiciousness.
